items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: Butch was going out of town or going someplace, and he asked me to do this article.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . I guess you could say writers for black newspapers alive today other than John Russo for any extended period of time. And Butch was going out of town or going someplace, and he asked me to do this article. I think he was ill at that time. And so I had just come off a road trip. I don't know, I just had some time off. Have you ever done a column before? Yeah, because I had written columns for the Informer Sentinel, which was a very large newspaper. That was another newspaper that we got off the…
When you're putting a column like this together, what do you have to do to put a column? It looks like a lot of work, is what I'm saying.
